description.value:
Frequency once per day

Traits Paradise-Touched

Once per day you may spend Bandwidth you do not have, taking your pool as low as −3. Your Bandwidth stays negative until it is restored: Re-sync raises it by 1 as normal. Your next daily preparations restore Bandwidth to your maximum minus the outstanding deficit; the debt is repaid from that pool before you can spend from it. While your Bandwidth is negative you cannot use any ability that costs Bandwidth, including this one.
